answer:
FINAL ANSWER: 673 CHIP variants remain after removing reference calls from the dataset.

Headline definition (as locked): among the 707 distinct (Chr:Pos, Ref/Alt) variants in the union of all 86 CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS workbooks, 673 keys have ≥1 explicit variant call (Zygosity = Heterozygous or Homozygous Variant) in at least one sample after dropping Zygosity == "Reference" rows and treating blank Zygosity as no-calls.

Execution evidence (analyze_chip.py, run end-to-end):
- Loaded 86/86 files; identical 33-column header in all; data from sheet row 3; per-file raw rows 635–705; total raw rows 57,258.
- Integrity asserts passed for every row: Filter == "PASS", In_CHIP == "True".
- Zygosity tally after within-file dedup: Reference 44,121 | Heterozygous 7,300 | Homozygous Variant 4,591 | blank 1,147.
- Deduplication (decision 6): 99 duplicate same-key rows collapsed within files before cross-sample aggregation.
- Blank-Zygosity verification (decision 3): of 1,147 blank rows, 1,072 have DP, GQ and VAF all missing; 75 have DP (74 also GQ) but effectively no VAF and no zygosity — no evidence of an alternate-allele call, supporting no-call treatment; blank rows cannot alter the headline because a key is retained only on explicit Het/Hom calls.
- Gene-list sensitivity (decision 2): call rows carry 8 non-Schenz overlapping symbols (GNAS-AS1, MFSD11, MMAB, MMACHC, RUNX1-IT1, SF3B2, TET2-AS1, TTC36-AS1); 46 keys are called only under such non-list symbols; strict exclusion would lower the figure to 627, but per the locked decision the headline stays 673 (In_CHIP flag accepted as the restriction). HRAS/NRAS have no rows in the catalog — a catalog observation, not a defect.

Sensitivity figures (explicitly NOT the answer):
(a) if blank-Zygosity-only keys also counted: 699;
(b) sample-level call rows remaining after dropping Reference: 13,038 including blanks, 11,891 with blanks also dropped;
(c) union key count before removal: 707 (only 8 keys were Reference-only in every sample; the rest of the 707→673 drop consists of sites never explicitly variant-called in any sample).

Cross-check: Variant ID agrees with the (Chr:Pos, Ref/Alt) key (no key carries conflicting IDs); Variant ID is sparse (empty on 17,137/57,258 rows), confirming (Chr:Pos, Ref/Alt) as the correct primary key.

Reproducibility parameters: openpyxl via load_workbook(..., data_only=True) with read_only=False REQUIRED (dimension-corrupt workbooks such as 502-P1 return 0 rows under read_only/dimension-trusting readers; pandas-equivalent handling = header=1, data from sheet row 3); sample IDs parsed from filenames; the script prints per-file row/dedup/call counts, filter tallies, dedup tally, gene sensitivity and the final number; full transcript saved to analysis_output.txt.
